mapper.sql: id, original_filename, content_type, md5, file_size, bucket_name, object_name, access_type, creator_id, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: insert into media_file ( original_filename, content_type, md5, file_size, bucket_name, object_name, access_type, creator_id ) values ( #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{md5}, #{fileSize}, #{bucketName}, #{objectName}, #{accessType}, #{creatorId} )
mapper.update: update media_file set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
select
from media_file where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
